import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Namibia boundaries (approximate center and bounds)
namibia = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[11.5, -17.5], [25.3, -17.5], [25.3, -29.0], [11.5, -29.0], [11.5, -17.5]]]
)

start_date = '2021-01-01'
end_date = '2021-02-01'

# Threshold: 7 inches = 177.8 mm
threshold_mm = 7 * 25.4

# 2. Data Acquisition
chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(namibia)

# Check if data exists
img_count = chirps.size().getInfo()
print(f"CHIRPS images found: {img_count}")

if img_count == 0:
    print("No precipitation data for January 2021.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Calculate total precipitation
    total_precip = chirps.select('precipitation').sum()
    
    # 4. Get statistics
    stats = total_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(
            reducer2=ee.Reducer.count(),
            sharedInputs=True
        ),
        geometry=namibia,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    mean_precip = stats.get('precipitation_mean')
    pixel_count = stats.get('precipitation_count')
    
    print(f"Valid pixels: {pixel_count}")
    print(f"Mean total precipitation: {mean_precip:.2f} mm")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if pixel_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif mean_precip is None or mean_precip < 0 or mean_precip > 2000:
        print("Invalid precipitation value.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"Threshold: {threshold_mm:.2f} mm ({7} inches)")
        
        if mean_precip > threshold_mm:
            print(f"YES: {mean_precip:.2f} mm > {threshold_mm:.2f} mm")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"NO: {mean_precip:.2f} mm <= {threshold_mm:.2f} mm")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
